findings.issue: Glossary freezes Inhabit Shell as سُكنى الهَيكل; this row renders the frozen verb as تلبُّس, so the same prompt reads two different ways in the same menu.
Glossary freezes Biosampler as جامع العينات الحيوية (Proxima); المِجسّ الحيوي ('bio-probe') is a different word for the frozen concept and will not match the many <Bold>Biosampler</> skill rows.
Glossary freezes Deadly Revelation as الوحي المُميت (Smert); الكشف القاتل breaks the ability name against its own skill descriptions.
The 'it' is the censer, rendered المِبخَرة (feminine) in the sibling prompt TouchCenserInteraction; the masculine إنه points at no antecedent on screen.

The same item is translated, not transliterated, in WeltcapPP_PassiveEffect_2 (قبعات الوَرَم), and the other mushroom/plant items follow the glossary's translate-don't-transliterate rule (Trollweed=عشب الغول, Tarspore=بوغة القار); the player sees two different names for one pickup.
